tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Create a new password-protected temporary WordPress site. No account needed. Returns the site name, a token (save it, it is shown once), the visitor login, the WordPress admin login and a claim link for the person.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: The sites in the Oxyforge account this connection belongs to (needs an account agent key, made in the members area under Connect MCP, my.oxyforge.com/mcp). Says whether the key may make changes.

tools.name: backup_site
tools.description: Take a backup of one of the account's sites now, before a risky change (account agent key that may make changes; one every few minutes per site).

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: State (provisioning, awake, asleep, ...), address, logins while unclaimed, claim link and clocks of a site.

tools.name: run_wp_cli
tools.description: Run one WP-CLI command on the site, without the leading "wp", e.g. "post create --post_type=page --post_title=About --post_status=publish --porcelain". Put long content in stdin and use "-" as the file argument. eval, shell and db import/export are not available.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or replace a file under wp-content/themes, wp-content/plugins or wp-content/uploads, e.g. path "themes/bakery/style.css". Folders are made as needed. Use content for text or content_base64 for binary (25 MB at most).

tools.name: read_files
tools.description: List a folder (a path without a file extension) or read a file under wp-content/themes, plugins or uploads.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a file or folder under wp-content/themes, plugins or uploads.

tools.name: login_link
tools.description: A one-use link into wp-admin, valid five minutes. The browser asks for the visitor login first.

tools.name: clear_cache
tools.description: Clear the page and object cache if a change does not show.

tools.name: delete_site
tools.description: Delete a site nobody has claimed yet. Cannot be undone.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_site" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "write_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
